response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.tradekind AS trader_type, c.cnt AS record_count, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, c.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Records are inner-joined to traders on exact text equality of trdref and tradereg; records without a matching trader are dropped. Traders with NULL tradekind form one group (GROUP BY treats NULLs as a single group).

The average is the plain average of the per-type counts (sum of counts divided by number of groups, including the NULL group), not a per-trader or per-record average. Results are unrounded; the share uses real division.
